```plato
    // The angular velocity change an angular impulse (newton-meter-seconds, world
    // frame) produces: I^-1 L, taken through the body's principal frame.
    AngularResponse(self: SolverBody3D, angularImpulse: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => ComponentProduct(
                angularImpulse.Transform(self.Orientation.Inverse),
                self.InverseInertia)
            .Transform(self.Orientation);
```
